versions.content: Disabled: If the function LinTrcv_SetWakeupMode is called with TrcvWakeupMode == LINTRCV_WUMODE_DISABLE, then the notifications for wakeup events are disabled on the addressed network. It is required by the transceiver device and the underlying communication driver to detect the wakeup events and store it internally in order to raise the event when the wakeup notification is enabled again.
